source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(out) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({out[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and out[0][c] != background]
    if horizontal:
        line = horizontal[0]
        marker = out[line][0]
        cells = [(r, c, out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if r != line and out[r][c] != background and out[r][c] != marker]
        if not cells:
            return out
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c, v in cells), max(r for r, c, v in cells)
        delta = (line + 1 - lo) if lo > line else (line - 1 - hi if hi < line else 0)
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r + delta, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        lo2, hi2 = min(r for r, c, v in moved), max(r for r, c, v in moved)
        marker_row = hi2 + 1 if lo2 > line else lo2 - 1
        if 0 <= marker_row < h:
            out[marker_row] = [8] * w
    elif vertical:
        line = vertical[0]
        marker = out[0][line]
        cells = [(r, c, out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if c != line and out[r][c] != background and out[r][c] != marker]
        if not cells:
            return out
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c, v in cells), max(c for r, c, v in cells)
        delta = (line + 1 - lo) if lo > line else (line - 1 - hi if hi < line else 0)
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r, c + delta, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        lo2, hi2 = min(c for r, c, v in moved), max(c for r, c, v in moved)
        marker_col = hi2 + 1 if lo2 > line else lo2 - 1
        if 0 <= marker_col < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][marker_col] = 8
    return out
'''
